messages.subject: I think we have the same account
messages.body:
Hello.

I don't know who you are, but I've been receiving your account notifications. Yesterday my recovery address changed. Then it changed back. Support says I must have done it myself.

They keep closing my reports because another report already exists. If you can read this, please reply. I don't want your account. I just want mine.
